finding: Honeycomb: highest max load at 50% strain and largest loop. Gyroid: lowest load and minimal energy absorption (softest and springiest).

finding: eTPU peak stress ~0.13 MPa (30%) / ~0.3 MPa (50%) / ~0.45 MPa (70%). Plateau from 10-30% strain at 30%. Densification beyond 50-60% strain at 70%. Repeated compression to densification WITHOUT FAILURE; absorbed 0.01-0.34 J/cm3 and recovered elastically; energy-absorbing efficiency comparable to closed-cell PU foams.
Grading significantly changes energy and damping profiles; lower peak loads in severe impacts; impact up to 270 mJ/cm3.
